gradient_shape: monotonic RISE with distance -- neighbours go DOWN, the OPPOSITE of the chain
verdict: CHAIN REFUTED, NOT MERELY UNSUPPORTED. Genes within 10 kb of a silenced TSS rise only 29.5% of the time against 46.5% in trans (p 9.44e-10), with median lfc -0.0752 against -0.0090 -- and the gradient is monotonic RISE with distance -- neighbours go DOWN, the OPPOSITE of the chain. Silencing a gene SUPPRESSES its neighbours rather than releasing them, which is the expected behaviour of KRAB-dCas9 CRISPRi spreading heterochromatin locally. The indirect-effect reading of the benchmark's positive-effect pairs therefore loses its proposed mechanism: the local consequence of silencing is co-repression, not de-repression. The POSITIONAL evidence is untouched -- those elements do sit beside other promoters -- but 'the neighbour was repressing the target' is now contradicted by measurement rather than merely unconfirmed by annotation.
